ThinkProctor SDK Documentation

Installation

Include the SDK using a script tag:

<script src="https://thinkx-suite-qa.thinkexam.com/ThinkProctor/thinkproc.umd.min.js"></script>

Initialization & Authentication

ThinkProctor.init() initializes and starts a proctoring session, establishing a connection with the ThinkProctor service, authenticating the user, and setting up the environment.

ThinkProctor.init({
  apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY",
  sdk_token: "asdc21ac2312dasdc31",
  unique_user_id: "myuser123",
  user_name: "my user",
  group_code: "mygroup123",
  group_name: "my group 123",
  template_code: "think_1723213123",
  language: "en",
  registration_id_url: "",
  registration_photo_url: "",
  session_token: "sce3sdc2ecs3qad3"
}).then(function(session_token){
   console.log("Session Started", session_token);
}).catch(function(error){
   console.log("Initialization Error", error);
});

Parameters (options object)

ParameterTypeRequired?DescriptionExample
apiKeyStringYesYour API key from ThinkProctor dashboard."YOUR_API_KEY"
sdk_tokenStringYesJWT created using your API secret."eyJhbGciOi..."
unique_user_idStringYesUnique user ID (email or numeric ID)."myuser123"
user_nameStringYesUser’s name for display."my user"
group_codeStringNoCode for grouping users."mygroup123"
group_nameStringNoReadable name of the group."my group 123"
template_codeStringYesDefines the proctoring template."think_1723213123"
languageStringNoLanguage of SDK UI (default: en)."en"
registration_id_urlStringNoURL of user’s registered ID.""
registration_photo_urlStringNoURL of user’s registered photo.""
session_tokenStringYesServer-generated session authentication token."sce3sdc2ecs3qad3"

Creating the sdk_token

The sdk_token is a JWT generated on your server and signed using your ThinkProctor API secret. It should include api_key, uuid, and group_code as payload.

var tokenPayload = {
  api_key: "YOUR_API_KEY",
  uuid: "myuser123",
  group_code: "mygroup123"
};

Error Handling

  • Invalid apiKey or sdk_token
  • Missing required parameters
  • Network connectivity issues
  • Invalid template_code

Tracking Events

Track custom events using the SDK.

ThinkProctor.trackEvent("event_name", { data: "value" });

Check & Verification

After initialization, run system and user verification using ThinkProctor.checkCompatibility(). It returns a Promise that resolves once verification completes.

ThinkProctor.checkCompatibility().then(()=>{
   ThinkProctor.launch();
});

Launch

Start the proctoring session after system verification.

ThinkProctor.launch();

Conclude / Complete / End Session

Call ThinkProctor.complete() to end the session and stop all running processes.

Note: If the browser closes before calling this function, the session remains marked as incomplete. 
ThinkProctor.complete();

Example Usage

<script src="https://cdn.example.com/thinkproc.min.js"></script>
<script>
ThinkProctor.init({
  apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY",
  sdk_token: "asdc21ac2312dasdc31",
  unique_user_id: "myuser123",
  user_name: "my user",
  group_code: "mygroup123",
  group_name: "my group 123",
  template_code: "think_1723213123",
  language: "en",
  session_token: "sce3sdc2ecs3qad3"
}).then(async function(session_token){
  await ThinkProctor.checkCompatibility();
  ThinkProctor.launch();
}).catch(function(error){
  console.log("Some Error", error);
});

// End session later
ThinkProctor.complete();
</script>
